August is pacing lower on both, and Polymarket is falling behind Kalshi faster than the mindshare data suggests.

items.title: Stripe Is Acquiring AI Router OpenRouter for +$8B
items.summary: OpenRouter's founder built OpenSea, then built "Stripe for AI." Now Stripe is buying the company in a massive deal.
